name: Fancy Paws by Mila Solis
niche: peluqueria canina / pet grooming (dog spa, daycare & boarding salon, not mobile)
address: 8357 NW 38th St, Pembroke Pines, FL 33024, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js). This is a walk-in studio inside a residential/commercial unit, not a mobile service: Google Maps labels the category 'Pet groomer' with a fixed storefront address, and the business's own promotional graphic (gmaps-1.jpg) reads 'Dog Spa, Daycare, Boarding' with a house icon (hospedaje) and a physical shop interior visible across all the real photos (grooming tables, salon wall art, a hand painted 'Grooming Salon' sign in one photo background).
phone_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js), matches the phone number given in the task brief and echoed by the third-party directory DogDog.org listing for the same name/address.
language_evidence: The owner's name (Mila Solis) and the Pembroke Pines area suggested possible Spanish, but all verifiable first-party text is in English: the business's own promotional graphic (gmaps-1.jpg) reads 'DOG SPA, DAYCARE, BOARDING' in English, the Google category is 'Pet groomer' (English), and all available Google review text (Marilyn Gomez, Reina Hernandez, Victoria Martinez, Jennifer Horenstein) is written in English. No Spanish-language captions, reviews or signage were found anywhere. Site built with English as the default/primary language and Spanish as the full secondary toggle (bilingual, as required).
has_own_site_evidence: 1) node scripts/gmaps_detail.js on the exact Maps URL returned website: null, with the raw Google panel showing the 'Add website' prompt (no website field at all) and a 'Suggest an edit / Add missing information' block, which Google only shows when no website is on file. 2) curl -sk/-o on 4 domain guesses (fancypawsbymilasolis.com, fancypawsbymila.com, fancypawspembrokepines.com, fancypawsmila.com) all failed with connect_unreachable / no public DNS record (the agent proxy explicitly reported no route, not a blocked/parked page). 3) WebSearch for '"Fancy Paws by Mila Solis" Pembroke Pines website' and for '"Fancy Paws by Mila Solis" Pembroke Pines instagram facebook' returned only third-party directory pages (DogDog.org, BBB, Care.com, BringFido, Homeguide, iHeartDogs) that explicitly say they could not link to an owned website; none linked an actual fancypaws.* domain. A separate same-name hit, 'Milas Grooming Boutique' on book.heygoldie.com, was checked and ruled out: that business is in Walnut, CA with a different address, not this one.

facebook.name: Fancy Paws by Mila Solis

instagram.evidence: Handle printed directly on the business's own promotional graphic (assets/raw/gmaps-1.jpg): 'INSTAGRAM @FANCYPAWSBYMS'. The profile could not be independently re-fetched in this session (Instagram returned HTTP 429 on a plain WebFetch, and a direct API probe with a custom header was blocked by this session's own permission policy), so reachability of the live profile is not independently reconfirmed beyond the business's own graphic; used as a secondary link in the footer only, not as a primary CTA.

email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field, website: null), the third-party DogDog.org directory listing (explicitly states it will not link an email/website), WebSearch for an Instagram/Facebook URL to check a bio link (none resolvable), and the book.heygoldie.com page that came up under a similar groomer name 'Mila's Grooming' (confirmed to be an unrelated business in Walnut, CA, not this one). Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's note that small walk-in pet-service businesses frequently do not publish an email; phone is the confirmed real channel here.

services.source: No price list or booking platform was found anywhere (no own site, no Booksy/Square/GlossGenius/Mangomint/Fresha/Vagaro link, no linktree). Service categories come from the business's own promotional graphic (assets/raw/gmaps-1.jpg, which literally reads 'DOG SPA, DAYCARE, BOARDING' with bath/house/scissors icons) and from repeated real-world service mentions Google extracted from the 57 reviews (sweet groomer x7, one-on-one grooming x2, gentle with dogs x4, picture updates x3, no cages x2, calm dog x3, patient groomer x2, attentive to requests x2). A third-party directory (DogDog.org) separately lists generic grooming line items (bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, de-shedding, teeth cleaning, flea/tick) consistent with a standard full-service dog groomer, used only as supporting context, not as a verified price source. Because no prices are publicly posted, the site uses the adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3.5: every service card reads 'Quote on call' / 'Se cotiza' with a direct tel: call-to-action, never an invented price.
list: Full Grooming (breed-appropriate haircut, bath, nail trim, ear cleaning, de-matting, finished with a Fancy Paws bandana or bow)
Doggy Daycare (calm, supervised daytime care, no cages, picture updates sent during the visit)
Overnight Boarding (home-like overnight stay at the studio)

reviews_verbatim.text: Mila is AMAZING ! She is so gentle with the dogs, our dogs love her and they always come out looking and smelling amazing ! Couldn’t recommend her more highly!

reviews_verbatim.text: Mila has been grooming my dog since her first cut. She always takes good care of Coco. Coco always leaves Fancy Paws happy, with a cute cut and smelling so good. Thank you for for treating Coco like your own. 💗 …

photo_curation_note: 11 real photos were retrieved from Google Maps via gmaps_photocycle.js; gmaps-2.jpg was an exact duplicate of gmaps-1.jpg (identical md5) and was excluded outright. The remaining 10 were inspected visually one by one with the Read tool (not chosen by filename): all show genuine dogs after real grooming sessions, good lighting, open eyes, happy expressions, no mid-procedure shots, no clutter, no selfies of the groomer. Of those 10, gmaps-1.jpg was identified as a marketing flyer rather than a dog photo (kept only as a data source) and gmaps-10.jpg was excluded for an on-image text caption ('Macarena'), leaving exactly 8 clean, distinct photos, each used exactly once across hero / about / gallery with zero repeats. All 8 used images were resized to a 1000px max dimension (ImageMagick mogrify, quality 82) per the performance rule before being referenced in the HTML. The real Fancy Paws logo (paw+house+scissors icon) was cropped directly out of gmaps-3.jpg's own bottom-left watermark (a real asset of the business, not a generated one) and saved as assets/raw/logo.jpg for the nav/footer avatar and favicon.
brand_vibe: Built on templates/light-v2, repainted into a new jade/mint spa palette (accent-deep #1f7a63, accent-mid #4caf8f, warm mint-cream bg #f6fbf8) derived from the business's own real branding: the Fancy Paws logo and bandanas seen across the real photos are teal/mint, and the salon's own walls are a soft light blue, so a light, airy base with a jade-mint accent was chosen over the darker base. This palette is distinct from every previously used Siteforge palette (not the gold original, not coral/caramelo/esmeralda/teal-acero #4fb8b8/violeta/rosa/mare's blue-teal #296167).
variant_note: Built with the adapted no-booking/no-price variant (PIPELINE.md Fase 3.5, same family as output/rtdiagnostichialeahgardens/data.json and output/prestigeautocargo/content.json): no Booksy/Square/GlossGenius/Mangomint listing exists, so every 'Book' button and price slot became a tel: call CTA reading 'Quote on call' / 'Se cotiza', the testimonials are real Google quotes (not invented reasons), and the location card points to the real walk-in address with hours, with a Google Maps link used wherever the skeleton originally pointed to Instagram (since Instagram reachability was not independently reconfirmed this session).
